battery.capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: 82 kWh gross MEB pack has 77 kWh usable (VW figure relayed by SlashGear 2023 first drive; Wikipedia agrees). The 2026 Standard/AWD is the same 82 kWh AWD pack as 2024-2026 Pro (vw.com lists only 82 kWh-class Pro/AWD trims for 2026); nothing shows a pack change.

battery.nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: Guide Auto lists the Canadian 2025 ID.4 Pro AWD 82 kWh pack at 400 V (MEB); same pack carried to 2026.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: vw.com 2026 ID.4 page says up to 11 kW home charging; SlashGear 2023 and VW 2021 launch release give an 11 kW onboard charger on the 82 kWh pack; same charger carried to 2026.
